title: Hot Works Permit
name: Hot Works Permit
description: Hot-work permit covering ignition hazards, gas cylinders, ventilation, alarm isolation, fire watch and post-work inspection.

sections.title: PRE-WORK FIRE AND EXPLOSION CONTROLS
items: Combustibles are removed or protected
Voids and opposite sides of surfaces are checked
Adjacent levels are assessed for spark and heat migration
Flammable liquids and gases are removed or made safe
Explosive-atmosphere risks are considered
Suitable extinguishers are immediately available
Escape routes remain available
Other workers and public are protected

fields.label: Combustibles Removed / Protected and Adjacent Areas Checked
Fire Extinguisher Type, Quantity and Location

sections.title: EQUIPMENT, CYLINDERS AND VENTILATION
items: Hot-work equipment is checked before use
Gas cylinders are secured and protected
Fuel gas and oxygen equipment are controlled against leaks
Ventilation is sufficient for fumes and gases
LEV / RPE is provided where required
Equipment is isolated or secured when work stops

fields.label: Hot Work Equipment / Cylinder Check Details

sections.title: FIRE ALARM / DETECTOR ISOLATION
items: Fire detection remains operational unless isolation is necessary
Any isolation is specifically authorised
Isolation is limited to minimum area and time
Compensatory fire controls are in place
Person responsible for reinstatement is identified

sections.title: FIRE WATCH AND POST-WORK INSPECTION
items: Named fire watcher can stop the work
Fire watcher has no conflicting duties
Sparks, slag and heat migration are monitored
Adjacent spaces are checked where necessary
Work stops if controls become ineffective
Immediate post-work inspection is completed
Fire watch continues for the period defined by assessment / site procedure
Final re-inspection is completed before closure

fields.label: Required Post-work Fire Watch Duration / Basis

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Isolated fire detection is fully reinstated
Gas cylinders and equipment are removed or stored safely
Temporary fire controls are removed only when safe
Area is free from heat / fire hazards
Permit issuer and holder agree permit can close

fields.label: Fire Alarm / Detector Reinstated Date / Time
